correctness.rationale: The exact planar difference reduction proves unique equilibrium by odd-cycle sign alternation. Strict rearrangement yields \(\dot R/2=(3/2-v)R-T\) with \(T>0\) whenever \(R>0\). The exact cubic identity gives \(T=R^2+O(R^3)\), hence \(tR\to1/2\) at criticality. Above the threshold, positivity of the renormalized limit follows from integrability of \(T/R\). Below it, the only planar equilibrium is a hyperbolic source, so every bounded nonsynchronous planar omega limit is periodic by Poincaré–Bendixson, and the stable mean equation lifts that orbit. Exact integer-algebra and representative trajectories were verified.
